digest: Jensen Huang's resignation and leadership turmoil at Nvidia have sparked executive calls for his return and put intense focus on upcoming earnings and regulatory scrutiny.
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, including tanker fires in Hormuz and strikes in the Gulf, are rattling regional bourses and global markets.
Japan's economy contracted unexpectedly in the third quarter as expired energy subsidies and higher energy prices took a toll.
Anthropic is launching an IPO, providing a crucial test for investor sentiment in the embattled AI trade.
A nationwide FAA ground stop and lingering air travel disruptions have drawn scrutiny from Washington regarding aging infrastructure funding.
